# Utilities

Hooks and functions used together with the components: delayed loading states, icon names, command matching.

## matchCommands

Filters and ranks items for a query, as the command palette does. The query is split at whitespace and every
word must match (case-insensitive): as consecutive text in the title or the keywords, or as letters that appear
in order in the title (fuzzy, such as `dvc` for "Dev Center"). Matches at the start of the title rank first,
then at the start of a word of the title, inside the title, in the keywords, and fuzzy matches last; with several
words, the ranks of the words add up. Items with the same rank keep their order. An empty query returns all items.

`items` are any objects with a `title` and optional `keywords` (a string or an array of strings); `query` is the
text typed by the user. Returns a new array with the matching items, best first; `items` is not changed. Use it to
filter your own list the way CommandPalette does.

```ts
matchCommands<T extends CommandMatchable>(items: readonly T[], query: string): T[]
```

## iconNames

The names of all registered icons, in registration order. Use it where every icon is listed, such as an icon
overview or an icon picker.

```ts
const iconNames: readonly IconName[]
```

## isIconName

Checks whether a value is the name of a registered icon, and narrows its type to `IconName`. Use it for names that
come from untyped data, such as a menu configuration loaded at runtime, before passing them to Icon.

```ts
isIconName(name: unknown): name is IconName
```

## useDelayedPending

Delayed appearance of loading states: returns whether a loading state (a skeleton, a loading indicator) should be
shown now. It becomes `true` only after `pending` has lasted `delay` (200 ms by default), and once `true` it stays
so for at least `minDuration` (400 ms by default), even if `pending` has already ended. Fast loads therefore show
no loading state at all, and slower ones do not make a skeleton flash.

`pending` is whether something is loading, such as `query.isPending` or `query.isFetching`; `opts` sets `delay`
and `minDuration` in milliseconds. For a first load, also include `pending` in the condition,
`if (query.isPending || showSkeleton) return <PageSkeleton />`: the skeleton mounts as soon as loading starts, its
own 200 ms delayed fade-in hides fast loads, and this hook keeps it for at least 400 ms. When refreshing keeps the old data and only shows an indicator over it, mount the indicator
only while this hook returns `true`, and give Loading `immediate` so that it is not delayed twice.

```ts
useDelayedPending(pending: boolean, opts?: DelayedPendingOptions): boolean
```

## Types

Types of this library used above. Import them with `import type { … } from 'vellum-ui'`.

### IconName

Name of a registered icon. Only the icons listed here can be used; they are Lucide icons under shorter names
(`trash` is Lucide's `Trash2`, `more` is `Ellipsis`). All names at runtime: `iconNames`.

Values: `"search"`, `"link"`, `"at"`, `"sort"`, `"filter"`, `"user"`, `"sparkles"`, `"file-text"`, `"activity"`, `"aperture"`, `"archive"`, `"arrow-left"`, `"arrow-down"`, `"arrow-right"`, `"arrow-up"`, `"ban"`, `"banknote"`, `"bell"`, `"bell-off"`, `"book"`, `"bot"`, `"braces"`, `"brain"`, `"briefcase"`, `"building"`, `"calendar"`, `"chart"`, `"check"`, `"chevron-down"`, `"chevron-left"`, `"chevron-right"`, `"alert"`, `"check-circle"`, `"circle-dashed"`, `"x-circle"`, `"approval"`, `"clock"`, `"code"`, `"columns"`, `"command"`, `"contact"`, `"copy"`, `"enter"`, `"crown"`, `"database"`, `"download"`, `"more"`, `"external-link"`, `"file-image"`, `"eye"`, `"eye-off"`, `"folder"`, `"grip"`, `"folder-open"`, `"project"`, `"handshake"`, `"hard-drive"`, `"hash"`, `"home"`, `"hourglass"`, `"image"`, `"images"`, `"inbox"`, `"info"`, `"kanban"`, `"key"`, `"finance"`, `"layers"`, `"dashboard"`, `"grid"`, `"list"`, `"loader"`, `"lock"`, `"logout"`, `"message"`, `"messages"`, `"monitor"`, `"move"`, `"moon"`, `"org"`, `"package"`, `"rows"`, `"palette"`, `"sidebar"`, `"attach"`, `"edit"`, `"pin"`, `"pin-start"`, `"pin-end"`, `"plus"`, `"power"`, `"receipt"`, `"refresh"`, `"reply"`, `"rotate-ccw"`, `"scan-search"`, `"send"`, `"settings"`, `"share"`, `"shield"`, `"smile"`, `"compose"`, `"star"`, `"stop"`, `"sun"`, `"thumbs-down"`, `"thumbs-up"`, `"trash"`, `"truck"`, `"undo"`, `"upload"`, `"user-minus"`, `"user-plus"`, `"users"`, `"wallet"`, `"webhook"`, `"close"`, `"zap"`

### DelayedPendingOptions

Options of useDelayedPending.

| Field | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delay` | `number` | Milliseconds the loading must last before the loading state is shown. | `200` | No |
| `minDuration` | `number` | Minimum milliseconds the loading state stays shown once it has appeared, even if the loading has ended. | `400` | No |
